sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Access secure services, view your details and lodge online.

Check if you need to declare foreign income and pay tax, the tax you pay depends on your residency for tax purposes.

As an Australian resident for tax purposes, you must declare any foreign income you earn on your Australian tax return.

Income you need to declare depending on your residency status and whether you are also a temporary resident.

Employment income from certain types of international work may be exempt from Australian tax.

If you are coming to Australia or going overseas, you may need to work out your residency for tax purposes.
